testCases.title: Display of Brand Filter Checkboxes
steps: Navigate to the product overview page.
expectedResults: Brand filter checkboxes are displayed on the product overview page.

testCases.title: Selecting Brand Checkboxes Updates Product Grid
steps: Navigate to the product overview page.
Select one or more brand checkboxes.
expectedResults: Product grid updates to show only the selected brands.

testCases.title: Filtering by Both Categories and Brands
steps: Navigate to the product overview page.
Select one or more category checkboxes.
Select one or more brand checkboxes.
expectedResults: Product grid shows only products that match the selected categories and brands.
